data.title: Malaga vs Real Sociedad - prediction, preview & betting tips - 18/10/2026
data.content:
With 13 points earned from a possible 24, the Basque outfit are sixth in La Liga at the time of writing. They will be without the injured Alvaro Odriozola (ACL), Jon Aramburu (muscle), and Luken Beitia (sprained (ankle), as well as the suspended Pablo Marin, who was sent off in the team's 3-2 victory over Deportivo La Coruna last weekend. [...] Ahead of this clash, Juan Funes' side find themselves at the bottom of the La Liga table. They are without a win in 10 consecutive matches across all competitions.

Malaga are plagued with injuries, with as many as five players sidelined for this skirmish, including Aaron Ochoa (meniscus), Juan Cruz (hamstring), Jens-Lys Cajuste (muscle), Julen Lobete (cruciate ligament), and Diego Murillo (cruciate ligament). [...] Both teams share a 2-2-2 win-draw-loss record in the last six H2Hs, and while Real Sociedad won their last meeting in the Copa del Rey two years ago, Malaga have won the last two clashes between these teams in this competition.
